# parseSpecJson

## Summary

Extracts and parses the sculpt-spec JSON out of a raw model reply. It strips markdown code fences, slices from the first `{` to the last `}`, and on a parse failure retries once with trailing commas removed (a common LLM slip). It throws if no JSON is present or if `components` is missing/empty, and normalizes `materials` to an array.

## Import

```ts
import { parseSpecJson } from '../util/spec-io';
```

## Usage

It is the default `parser` argument of `requestSpec` in `../util/llm-request`, so any spec-stage vision call that does not pass its own parser runs its reply through this function. Its "did not return JSON / no components" error messages are what the retry loop in `requestSpec` matches to trigger a corrective re-ask.
